policy: Fail closed. A watched target becomes PROMOTION_READY only when the existing Human Bridge strict provider chain independently returns an exact-species orthologue with validated human target context. Sequence similarity, antibody cross-reactivity, nearby species, or genome presence alone never count as strict orthology.

targets.genome_notes: GCA_984792215.1 is a chromosome-scale 2026 Paracentrotus lividus assembly; genome availability is a discovery aid, not itself orthology proof.
targets.promotion_rule: Require exact Paracentrotus lividus sequence identity/provenance plus a paralogue-aware orthology chain to human AQP3 from an accepted provider or an explicit phylogenetic dossier, followed by Open Targets validation. Genome presence, inherited Strongylocentrotus gene_name, BLAST similarity, antibody cross-reactivity, or AQP-family membership alone must fail closed.

2026_chromosome_assembly.role: exact-species discovery substrate only; not orthology proof

consortium_annotation.annotation_note: gene_name may be inherited from Strongylocentrotus BLAST similarity; therefore names alone cannot promote strict orthology
consortium_annotation.role: candidate discovery and paralogue enumeration only

explicitly_not_targets.reason: Current verified translation is an exogenous ice-binding/antifreeze-protein intervention. Forcing an endogenous orthologue would change the scientific claim and is therefore excluded.
